summary.text: Rodney Schamerhorn is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 24 (Beauregard, Sabine and Vernon parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Rodney Schamerhorn's occupation as Retired, Trucking, Site Work, Rolloff Container Service, Demo and Construction Debris Landfill.
It lists education as Louisiana College; Northwestern State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, House and Governmental Affairs, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and the Legislative Audit Advisory Council, and caucus affiliations including the Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
